title: A registered test module whose file is not in the commit builds nowhere but on the machine that has it
body:
Found 2026-09-12: d4d7aec2b carried a `suite.rs` registration for a file only one node had, and HEAD could not build its test target until 5746e02e. A pre-commit arm that refuses a `suite.rs` naming a `#[path]` the index does not carry is small. hv's to rule; cc's if ruled. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/suite_path_check.sh` refuses a commit whose staged `suite.rs` registers a `#[path]` the commit does not carry. It reads the index, so the answer is about what lands, not what one machine has. It carries a red and a green control on every run and exits 0, 1 or 2. It is rostered gated in `runner_roster_check.sh` and runs in `bin/devbin precommit` after the shared-build guard. Judged on edc9af155 plus the CI group (scratchpad batch/judge-ci-edc9af155.txt): "every #[path] a staged suite.rs registers is in the commit (both controls fired)", and the roster reads every disposition as matching the runner.
